newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 8.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- The ruling New Korea Party conducted a sweeping reshuffle of its top officials, changing all of the three key post holders.
- Typhoon 'Tina' is heading north and likely to reach the southern part of the Korean peninsula early Saturday morning, the Korean Meteorological Administation said.
- President Kim Young-sam on Thursday appointed Vice Justice Minister Kim Tae-joung as prosecutor-general in a reshuffle following Tuesday's cabinet shakeup.
- Eight survivors of the fiery crash of a Korean Air Lines jumbo jet in Guam were airlifted to Seoul in early Friday morning.

- South and North Korea, the United States and China agreed to hold formal peace negotiations in Geneva during their second day of preparatory talks in New York Wednesday, a Foreign Ministry offical said.

- A joint investigation team, comprising 37 officials from the Korean aviation authorities and the U.S. National Transporation Safety Board(NTSB), will begin an extensive investigation today of the KAL flight 801 crash site in Guam in which a least 225 died.
